name: PCT Guamá
evidence: Science & technology park in Belém running a continuous 'empresa associada' residency/selection edital (nº 001/2026, Feb 2026) plus a committee-run 'Espaço Inovação' startup selection, and it joined the Pan-Amazon incubator/accelerator network (Ripa) in 2026.

name: Sebrae Catalisa ICT
evidence: National Sebrae deep-tech acceleration program; 2025 edital registrations (extended to March 9, 2025) selected up to 2,000 research projects for a 3-month mobilization phase, followed by 9-month validation and a 12-month scale-up acceleration phase with funding up to R$200k.

name: Novo Seed
evidence: Minas Gerais state government relaunched SEED in 2026 with R$15M for a new decentralized startup-acceleration edition (call for proposals to parks/incubators/accelerators, applications open until April 9, 2026), per multiple 2026 government/news sources, even though the on-file seed.mg.gov.br URL returned 404 on every path we tried. [Rebranded Novo Seed (2026-08-23).] [Link now live (2026-08-23).]

name: Social Good Brasil
evidence: Own website confirms this is an NGO/civil-society organization (founded 2012, UN Foundation partnership) running data-for-good training, leadership programs and an annual festival (2026 edition upcoming) — not a startup accelerator; no cohort, edital, or demo-day activity was found.

name: Spacemoon
evidence: Formerly a Santos-based 'Boutique de Inovação' running an accelerator program for startups; search results indicate it ceased operations in 2021, and its domain (with or without www) no longer resolves at all (DNS failure), consistent with shutdown.

name: Startup RIO
evidence: Rio de Janeiro state's flagship digital-entrepreneur acceleration program continues to run, now under startuprio.rj.gov.br and the related 'Hub RJ Startup' edital; the 2025 edition carried a record R$12M investment (up to R$80k/project plus mentorship), with the submission deadline extended to May 30, 2025. The Dealroom-listed startuprio.org domain no longer resolves (DNS failure). [Website updated 2026-08-23: on-file URL now live.]

name: Supernova
evidence: The on-file domain now hosts an unrelated telecom/AI/healthcare company (a Vivo-network MVNO with WhatsApp automation and telehealth services) with 19 years of history and no trace of the accelerator; the original 'Supernova Aceleradora de Startups' (Curitiba, 2 cohorts/year, 4% equity) listing on CODEMEC is dated 2014 with no evidence of activity since.

name: Techmall
evidence: Website returns HTTP 410 Gone (explicitly removed). Techmall was historically one of Brazil's larger accelerators (Startup Brasil-accredited, ~400 startups accelerated), but all discoverable coverage of its cohorts dates to 2014-2016 with no evidence of any activity in the last 24 months.

name: The Jump Brazil
evidence: The Dealroom-listed hubgoias.org is entirely unrelated — it belongs to 'Hub Goiás', a state innovation hub in Goiânia with its own accelerator programs (ELEVE II, GovTech, Epicentro), with no connection to Recife. The real Jump Brasil (Porto Digital's accelerator) lives at jumpbrasil.org and has run continuous cohorts of 'Mind the Bizz' pre-incubation and 'Incubação JUMP', including 2025.1 (deadline Feb 23, 2025) and 2025.2 (deadline Aug 15, 2025) editions. [Closed (per review 2026-08-23).]
